result:
No failures (the warnings are pre-existing, about controllers with no test files).

The bug was in `PostController.search` (`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts:34`): the `published` filter was added as `q.orWhere('published', true)` *inside* the same callback group as the keyword conditions, so the compiled SQL was `title LIKE ? OR excerpt LIKE ? OR ... OR published = true` — every published post matched regardless of the keywords (the padding the reporter noticed), and every keyword match came back regardless of its published state (the leak). I removed that line from the group and applied `.where('published', true)` as a top-level AND on the query builder, so the search now compiles to `(title LIKE ? OR excerpt LIKE ? OR …) AND published = true`, matching the grouping pattern documented in `.claude/rules/orm-models.md`. I also expanded `tests/PostController.test.ts` with fixture data (a published and two unpublished posts sharing the `zephyrquill`/`marmalade` words, plus a published post matching nothing) and three cases covering single-keyword search, multi-keyword search, and a word that appears only in unpublished posts; `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass.
